name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Lemon Cherry Gelato + Bubble Gum Kush
description:
Bright citrus and sweet cherry notes from Lemon Cherry Gelato meet nostalgic bubblegum sweetness. Smooth, flavorful, and perfectly balanced whether flipped or blended.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
